On the 15th of March at 23:00 in the Rybnitsa area, deserted to the right bank a Red Army soldier of the UNR guard (company 1032) [...] born in 1909, member of the Komsomol, miner from Ranenburg Region. Venger's desertion to the right bank was committed while he was on duty as a sentry guarding the UNR facility No. 269. The moment of Venger's crossing to the right bank was noticed by a replacement Red Army soldier of the same facility Romanov. The latter, in order to prevent Venger's desertion to the right bank, opened fire on Venger from a rifle, to which he responded with two shots from the right bank. Red Army soldier Venger had a weapon with him. A guard detachment of the Rybnitsa outpost was located 450 meters from this facility, and they did not notice the external demarcations. An investigation is underway.

According to the legal data of the INO, on March 15, at 8 o'clock, in the area of ​​the city of Tiraspol', Sidorov I. I., a former officer, crossed from the left to the right bank. Having been detained by the guards of the right bank and taken to the picket "Migai-Vityaz", he stated that he was an officer of the former tsarist army, was escaping from the Bolshevik hell and that he had extensive connections among prominent people in Romania. The picket chief, without giving Sidorov any explanations or answers, ordered him to immediately return to the left bank. When Sidorov categorically refused to return, the picket chief barked at the platoon commander, from whom he received orders to forcefully expel the violators back. The platoon commander's orders were carried out to the letter. Sidorov was severely beaten, pushed onto the ice and forced at gunpoint to return to the left bank.

On the 20th of March at 10:00 in the Kamenka region, the citizen of Kamenka Demyan Sanalatii, Moldovan bedniak, single farmer, tried to cross to the right bank and was caught. The purpose of his crossing was to search for bread.
On the same day at 20:00 in the Speia area, [were] caught two teenagers trying to cross to the right bank [...]. Their aim was also to search for bread.

On the 20th of March at 09:00 in the Kamenka area at Checkpoint-1, one set of footprints [was found] leading past the demarcation from the left to the right bank. On the same day at 14:00 in the Rashkov area, one unknown woman broke through to the Right Bank and was shot at without result.

narrative: On the 22nd of March at 6am in the Butor area, 2 unknown violators broke through to the right bank, they were shot at without result.

narrative: On the 22nd of March at 24:00 in the Karantisk area, at the 3rd checkpoint, the local citizen Barginom caught, crossing from the right to the left bank, the defector - a soldier of the defence of the right bank [...] with a rifle and 9 rounds. The caught was taken to prison.

narrative: On the 23rd of March at 02:00 in the Butor area, at checkpoint-2, one set of footprints was found from the left to the right bank. In order to track the footprints [we] brought in the dog "Biainyi". The footprints could no be traced…

report_weather: Heavy snow fell over the past day. Frost. Wind.
narrative: On the same day, at 02:00 in the Chobruchi area, at checkpoint-4, the patrol of Maslovii and Tel'novii heard cries from about 600 to 800 metres from their position. They quickly ran to the sound of the cries and found 5 sets of footprints on the right bank and in the middle of the Dniester - 5 people had fallen through the ice. The whole group was shouting/crying for help and trying to get out of the water. After losing their strength they drowned.

report_weather: Heavy snow fell over the past day. Frost. Wind.
narrative: On the 23rd of March at 17:00 the command of the division 1043 Pavlom Voitlak caught a violator of the demarcation [...] crossing from the right bank. The purpose of the crossing was to search for work.

report_weather: Frost. A snowstorm passed over the right flank of the sector.
narrative: On the 24th of March at 24:00 in the Rognianskii area, at checkpoint-3, the patrol of division commander Grigor'evii and border guard commander Portnovii caught one violator crossing from the right to the left bank. He was called out to and he started to run in the direction of the demarcation. He was opened fire upon, wounded and captured. The captured turned out to be the inhabitant of the village of Malovatoe Andrei Alekseev, 21, bedniak, single farmer, excluded from the Komsomol for hooliganism. 2 months ago he emigrated to the right bank and was now returning. The captured is engaged in spying.

report_weather: Frost. A snowstorm passed over the right flank of the sector.
narrative: On the 24th of March at 15:00 in the Rybnitsa area at checkpoint 2, one unknown broke through from the left to the right bank who was shot at without result.

narrative: On the same day at 23:00 in the Malovatoe area at checkpoint 3, one unknown broke through from the left to the right bank. He was not shot because the distance was too great

On the 25th of March at 06:00, the border guard Velizhanii caught the violator, while preparing to cross to the right bank, Ivan Khodet, 65 years old, a bedniak and single farmer, his wife and son, citizens of Slobodzeia. Their reason for crossing was a lack of funds/resources to survive.
On the same day…
On the 25th of March at 23:00 in the Ternovka area at checkpoint-4 [was] caught [...] crossing to the right bank of the Dniester.

On the same day at 17:00 in the Glinnoe area, the young border guard Mishulinii caught, while preparing to cross to the right bank, Maksim Sandul, 13, and Mikhail Vozyan, 15, from local poor kolkhoznik families. Their purpose for crossing to the right bank was to look for bread.

On the 26th of March at 23:00 in the Karagash area at checkpoint 4 [was] caught, while preparing to cross to the right bank, the family of Nikita Pavlov, seredniak and single farmer, consisting of 4 people.

On the 27th of March at 13:00 in the Glinnoe area at checkpoint-4 the young border guard Artemovii spotted two individuals carefully creeping towards the demarcation.When he shouted out to them, they began to run towards the right bank. As a result of the decisive use of [his] weapon, one was killed on the left bank and the other was captured. The killed turned out to be an employee of the UNR - Evgenii Kishkat and the captured turned out to be a deserter from the Red Army's 151st rifle division Leonid Platonov. From the interrogation of Platonov, we found out that he deserted from the rifles on the 25th of March together with Dmitrii Tansii and Grigorii Kozhukhar', with the aim of escaping to the right bank due to the difficult material conditions of their families. The leader of the group turned out to be Grigorii Kozhukhar' - a citizen of Korotnoe. As a result of the capture of Platonov, the following red army soldiers together with their families were also captured... [...].
On the same day at 18:00 in the Korotnoe area [we] caught, while preparing to cross to the right bank, [...]. Their reason for crossing was to search for bread.

On the 28th of March at 5am in the Kuchery region at checkpoint 3, the UNR caught a group of violators crossing from the right bank to the left bank, numbering 14 people (6 men, 6 women, 2 children). The captured are citizens of Kishinev. Among them are 2 industrial workers, 3 workers, and the rest are artisans. Their purpose for leaving was to look for work.
On the 28th of March at 4am in the Korotnoe area at checkpoint 4 [we] found 5 sets of footprints heading to the right bank, of these 2 belonged to adults and 3 belonged to children
On the 28th of March in the Korotnoe area at checkpoint 4 [we] found and caught Andrei Danich, a kulak, trying to cross to the right bank.
On the same day at 22:00 in around the same place [we] caught Grigorii Motornyi, citizen of Bendery, a worker, crossing from the right to the left bank in search of work.

On 15 June, at liaison point no. 3 of the Mixed Border Commission, the Romanian delegate handed over ten people who had crossed from the left to the right bank during the winter, among them Evgenii Petrovich Osadchuk, b. 1901, of Ianishevka, Kiev oblast, a chemistry student at the 2nd Moscow University, expelled from the VKP(b) for rightism, who crossed on 28 March on the Rybnitsa zastava sector. His personal documents were found on the island opposite the zastava, apparently thrown away as he crossed. He is held on suspicion of espionage; the others were released.
On 29 March at 05:00 in the Ternovka area, the patrol of Mulin and Gorshkov caught Dmitrii Zinchenko, a worker from Bendery, crossing from the right bank to look for work.
On the 29th of March at 24:00 in the Tiraspol' area [we] caught Varin Pakiov, 28, seredniak, crossing from the left to the right bank.
[Report text illegible in the photograph.]
On the same day at 15:00 in the Chobruchi area [...], 19, farmhand, of Chobruchi, was caught crossing from the left to the right bank.
On the same day at 17:00 in the same area [Chobruchi], border guard [...] caught [...] 10, son of a bedniak together with his brother Ivan 8, crossing to the right bank…

On the 29th of March at 19:00 in the Karanitskii area, at checkpoint-3, fled from the right to the left bank and caught - Andrei Tatarichin, 12, citizen of Telitsa in Bessarabia, unemployed.
On the 30th of March at 5am in the Nezavertailovka region, the patrolman Vlass'ii caught, while preparing to cross to the right bank: [...]. Their reason for crossing was to look for bread.

On the same day at 23:00 in the Korotnoe area the border guard Shtynovii caught [...] crossing to the right bank.
On the same day at 21:00 in the Nezavertailovka area, border guard Anisimovii caught [...] crossing to the right bank

On the 30th of March at 23:00 in the Tsybulevka area, at checkpoint 2, [were] caught 6 violators of the demarcation crossing from the right to the left bank. Their purpose for leaving was to look for work.
On the 31st of March at 6am in the Chobruchi area, the patrolman Chausovii caught, while preparing to cross from the left to the right bank [...]. Their reason for crossing was to look for bread.

On the 31st of March at 10am in the Glinnoe area, Anna Matveenko, 9, was caught while preparing to cross to the right bank. She is the daughter of a kulak who fled to the right bank in 1930 named Roman Matveenko
On the same day, at 20:00 in the same area [Glinnoe], patrolman Sharikovii caught [...] trying to cross from the left to the right bank.
On the 31st of March at 23:00 in the Korotnoe area, [...] crossed from the left to the right bank. The investigation is ongoing.
On the 1st of April at 3am in the Korotnoe area, [...] were caught while preparing to cross to the right bank. Their reason for crossing was to look for bread.
On the 1st of April at 5am in the Parkany area, the patrolman Ternovskii caught 10 people crossing from the right to the left bank…

report_weather: Thaw. Fog. Ice on the Dniester covered with water. In places the ice has come away from the banks.
narrative: On the 2nd of April at 1am in the Glinnoe area at checkpoint-4, the border guard Aleksandrovii caught, while preparing to cross to the right bank, a kulak family consisting of 7 people…

report_weather: Thaw. Fog. Ice on the Dniester covered with water. In places the ice has come away from the banks.
narrative: On the 2nd of April at 7am in the Chobruchi area, a patrol found 5 sets of footprints leading from the left bank to the right bank. Among these - 2 of the sets were childrens'. The investigations are ongoing.

report_weather: Thaw. Fog. Ice on the Dniester covered with water. In places the ice has come away from the banks.
narrative: On the 2nd of April at 21:00 in the Speia area at checkpoint-3, a patrol, hiding in secret, led by Kirilovii, with the help of the search dog "Venger", came across a group of unknown people from our side crossing the demarcation. Shining a spotlight on the group of violators, it turned out to be a group of 4 people. They were called out to, at which point none of them stopped and they began to run in different directions across the demarcation. In order to catch the violators, the leader let the dog "Venger" off the leash and also opened fire on them from his rifle. The whole group was caught. Prior to being captured, Evdokiia Bernover, 43, bedniak was killed by gunfire [as was] Zakharii, 17 bedniak... Vasilisa Lupulova was heavily injured and taken to hospital... Evgeniia Samoilova was heavily injured and taken to hospital... The violators were captures in the region of the left bank of the Dniester. According to protocol, the weapons were used correctly. The investigation is ongoing.

report_weather: Thaw. Fog. Ice on the Dniester covered with water. In places the ice has come away from the banks.
narrative: On the 2nd of April at 10am in the Korotnoe area at checkpoint-4, the patrolman Shtykovii caught [...] trying to cross from the left to the right bank. Their reason for crossing was to look for bread.

report_weather: Thaw. Fog. Ice on the Dniester covered with water. In places the ice has come away from the banks.
narrative: On the 2nd of April at 20:00 in the Rybnitsa area, 2 unknown individuals crossed to the left bank. The investigation is ongoing and the identity of the crossers have not been established.

report_weather: Thaw. Fog. Ice on the Dniester covered with water. In places the ice has come away from the banks.
narrative: On the same day at 09:00 in Speia, one set of footprints was found from the left to the right bank. The identity of the crosser has not been established.

report_weather: Warm weather has caused rapid melting. The ice has gone soft and come away from the banks, with water up to 1 m deep on top in places. The Nezavertailovka floodplains are flooded and impassable.
narrative: On the 3rd of April at 5am in the same area [Speia] hiding in secret, the border guard Stashkinii caught a group of violators crossing from the left to the right bank consisting of [...]
On the 26th of April at checkpoint 37, the citizens of Glinnoe [...] crossed to the right bank by boat together with Arsenii Kiblik. This was first reported in the April intelligence summary.
In the month of April, the exact date is unknown, in the same area [Chobruchi], Mavra Antos'eva, 45, a seredniak, and her two children swam to the right bank, leaving 2 grown up children at home.
In the month of April in [the sector of zastava 38] [...] swam to the right bank.
At the start of May [...] fled to the Romanian side. Investigations on these cases are ongoing.
At the start of May [...] fled to the Romanian side. Investigations on these cases are ongoing.
On the 3rd of May… [we] caught crossing to the right bank Dmitrii Purpan, his wife, their 4 children, and Petr Karaman, citizens of Chobruchi, seredniaks.
In the middle of May Pavel Josephich Goian, a seredniak with his family numbering three people, crossed to the Romanian side.
Around the same time [...] and [...] fled to the Romanian side.
Around the same time [...] and [...] fled to the Romanian side.
On the 23rd of May at 01:00 in the Parkany area, border guard Bornlovyi, while trying to cross from the right to the left bank, caught [...]. Their reason for crossing was to look for work.
On the 24th of May in the region of Tsurkary, which is the opposite bank of Nezavertailovka and the Troitskii border guard [post], [...] crossed from the left to the right bank…
On the 26th May in the same place [zastava 37], [...] swam to the right bank.
On the 30th of May at checkpoint 35 the citizens of Slobodzeia [...] swam across to the right bank.
In the last days of May at checkpoint 38 [...] swam to the right bank.
On the 1st of June, in the same area [zastava 38] [...] sailed to the right bank on floats. According to unverified information, a boat for the crossing was provided to them from the Right Bank.
On the 2nd of June in Chobruchi [...] swam to the right bank.

On the 7th of June, citizen of Chobruchi Akim Konstantinov appeared at the office of the 4th Commandment and testified that his brother Petr Konstantinov, a seredniak aged 35, at night on the 3rd of June crossed on a raft from the left bank to the right bank, together with his wife and their 4 children. They made the raft themselves - made from the doors of their hut, on which the children sat while the adults swam beside it [pushing it].
On the 5th of June at 20:00 at checkpoint-4 [we] caught Savva Niryak, a kulak…
On the same day at 23:00…. [...] were caught preparing to cross to the Right Bank [prior to crossing].
On the 6th of June at 16:00 at checkpoint-2 someone swam from the left bank to the right bank - one unknown individual
On the same day at checkpoint 7, two brothers [...] swam to the right bank. Citizens of Strointsy, seredniaks. Their reason for leaving has not been established. The investigation is ongoing.
On the 7th of June at 5am in the morning at the 31st checkpoint, the Red Army command caught Romanian Soldier Gutsu Georgii Stepanovich, crossing to our side…
On the 8th of June at 23:00 a militia member caught, without documents [...] trying to cross to the right bank.

On the 9th of June at 24:00 in the Slobodzeia area… a citizen of Slobodzeia Grigorii Sidorenko, 28, kulak… tried to swim to the right bank, where he has relatives. The people who caught him were rewarded.
On the 9th of June at 24:00 in the Parkany area, the comman UNR 1042 caught [...], citizens of Bendery, labourers, crossing from the right bank in search of work.

On the 10th of June, in the same area [Slobodzeia], according to the testimony of the former, the citizens of Slobodzeia [...] were preparing to cross to the right bank with his wife and 2 adult children. The float/raft was built in their house with their own strength. The whole Foksha family was swollen with hunger that they tried to move to the right bank.

On the same day, at 19:00 in the Chobruchi area, patrolman Abrovkinii caught, while preparing to swim to the right bank, kolkhozniks from Chobruchi… Their reason for leaving was that they didn't have any means to exist.

At night on the 13th of June in the Rybnitsa area representatives of the Rybnitsa Selsoviet - Lipatov and instructor of the raion fruit-and-vegetable union Todosii, both members of the Communist Party, crossed from the left to the right bank. On June 12, the above-mentioned persons were charged in the investigative order with a number of official crimes committed, as well as distortions of the party's policy in the village. The measure of restraint chosen for them was to remain at large until the Court's decision. This, almost certainly, was their reason for fleeing to the right bank...

On the 14th of June at 17:00 in the Popenki area, the citizen of Popenki Anastasiia Bushichka 17, izveshensha, crossed from the left to the right bank. Her reason for leaving has not been established. Part of the demarcation line was found on the ground in the same area.

On the 15th of June at 1am a patrol in the Glinnoe area consisting of Utomovii, born in 1909, saw one man and one woman trying to float from the left to the right bank. He called out to them, and after they ignored him, he began to shoot from his rifle. The woman swam back and was captured, but the man continued to the right bank under fire. The captured turned out to be the citizen of Glinnoe, [...], bedniak, 15. The one who made it to the right bank was also a citizen of Glinnoe, [...], a seredniak, 24. Their reason for fleeing was a lack of food. The main reason that the shooting failed was the fog, [which prevented the shooting successfully at a distance of only 70-100 metres in the 'night conditions'].

On the 15th of June in the Slobodzeia area [someone] found on the bank of the Dniester trousers and a shirt. It seems that at this spot one violator swam to the right bank. The identity of the crosser has not been established.

On the 16th of June at 3am in the Slobodzeia area, hiding in secret the border guard Vrovkinii caught: [...], citizens of Slobodzeia, trying to float to the right bank in boxes/crates… their reason for leaving was to look for bread.

On the 18th of June at 18:00 Chobruchi patrolman Avroskinii saw, 120 metres away, an unknown woman swimming from the left to the right bank. As a result of the decisive use of weaponry, the border guard opened fire after exhausting all possible warnings. The woman was shot and drowned in the waters of the Dniester. It was established that the killed was the citizen of Chobruchi [...], 43, bedniak. Her husband had crossed to the right bank in the Autumn of 1931. There is an investigation ongoing into the use of weapons.

On the same day at 23:00 in the same area [Chobruchi] [we] caught [...], bedniaks, citizens of Chobruchi preparing to cross the river in a raft to the right bank together with three children. The float was made from the home of Cheban. Their reason for crossing was a lack of food.
On the same day at 24:00, border guard Nechvolod caught [...], 20, citizen of Chobruchi trying to cross to the right bank to meet up with relatives there.

On the same day at 15:00, a patrol in Nezavertailovka consisting of Rolubevii caught, while preparing to cross on a float to the right bank, the citizens of Nezavertailovka [...]. Their reason for leaving was the same [no food].
On the 18th of June at 18:00 in the Chobruchi area, [...], 18, crossed [swam] from the left bank to the right bank and was shot at without result from 700 metres away by the patrol of [...].

At night on the 18th of June, from the village of Chobruchi the following local citizens crossed to the right bank: [...]. These families were already registered as exhibiting the signs of preparing to cross to the right bank. The precise data on their departures is unknown. Investigations are ongoing.
On the 19th of June in the Karagash zastava area [we] caught [...], 32, seredniak, inhabitant of Balta trying to swim to the right bank. The caught was engaged in spying.
On the same day at 09:00 in the Chobruchi area, the following people were caught while trying to cross the river to the right bank on a float, all kolkhozniks from Chobruchi…

On the same day at 16:00 the border guard of the same area [Chobruchi], Nichvoloda saw, 200 metres away in the river Dniester, an unknown man swimming to the right bank. After firing a warning shot [to stop], the guard shot one bullet at the man, which hit him and he drowned in the waters of the river Dniester. The identity of the violator has not been established. Of the use of weapons an investigation is being conducted.

On the same day at 20:00 in the same area, border guard Sokolovii caught the citizens of Chobruchi [...], trying to swim across the river to the right bank. Their reason for leaving was the same [food].

On the same day at 23:00 the border guard in the same region - Sandul saw a man 40 metres away, quickly swimming from the left bank to the right bank of the Dniester. After firing a warning shot [to stop], the guard shot at him from a rifle. The second bullet hit him and he drowned in the River Dniester. An investigation into the use of weaponry is ongoing. There is also an investigation to establish the identity of the deceased.

On the same day at 24:00 in the same area [Chobruchi], border guard T. Karamshevii… caught, the citizen of Chobruchi Petr Tervul, aged 32, bedniak, trying to swim to the right bank. His reason for leaving was the same [no food].

On June 19, at 19 o'clock, the lookout of the Chobruchi outpost - border guard NICHVOLOD noticed an unknown man 600 meters away, talking from the left bank with one Romanian border guard, who was on the right bank of the Dniester River. During the surrounding search for the unknown, the lookout was noticed by a Romanian border guard, who called out to the unknown as the lookout approached. The unknown immediately fled and disappeared in our rear, having been fired upon in vain by 3 shots fired by a soldier, after precautionary measures for detention. On the way of escape - traces of blood were found. But the possibility that the hiding man was wounded is excluded.

On 20 June at 24:00, on the sector of zastava 29, a patrol noticed two men lying near the demarcation; after a warning shot they were detained. Both were residents of Moscow: Georgii Anatol'evich Elizarov, b. 1910, clerk-translator of the Scientific-Methodological Committee of Narkompros RSFSR, a graduate of the Moscow Institute of New Languages, whose father, a former second lieutenant in the tsarist army and regimental commander in the Red Army, now works as a bookkeeper in a Moscow state printing house; and Vladimir Alekseevich Chernyshev, b. 1909, bookkeeper at the OGIZ publishing house, with secondary education, whose mother works as a ticket inspector in a Moscow cinema. They had tried to cross the Dniester using three football bladders. Reason for crossing: 'thirst for travel'. They have no relatives abroad and are not under suspicion.
On the same day at 17:00 at checkpoint 37 - border guard Fedorunskii caught the citizen of Glinnoe, Nikita Todorashko, 23, kolkhoznik, swimming to the right bank…

On 20 June three residents were found missing from the village on the sector of zastava 34: Vladimir Bogatyi, 22, bedniak; Savva Chekan, 27, kolkhoznik, VKP(b) member; and Georgii Chekan, 19, kolkhoznik, fisherman. They are presumed to have crossed to the right bank; this is being checked. Georgii Chekan had been held by the Romanian guard on 2 June with a group of fishermen and then returned.

On the 20th of June at 12:00 on the right bank in the region north east of the city of [...] there stood one man in a black suit… [who] looked at the territory of the left bank from a garden. At 14:00, the same man reappeared on the riverbank,… rushed into the river Dniester and tried to swim to the left bank. Somewhere in the middle of the river... shouted "Give me a float, save me!" and drowned.

On the 21st of June at 17:00 the patrol of the Tiraspol' region, led by border guard Nersan Bodrov (born in 1908) noticed one unknown man looking out from behind the bushes at the location of the guard patrol and observing the opposite side. The border guard caught him. Upon interrogation, it was determined that the captured was [...]. On the purpose of his crossing to the Right Bank, Maier said that he considered himself to be a Trotskyist; in all fields he considered himself to be an enemy of Comrade Stalin; so that in September 1930 he left Marx, Volga region, to go to Moscow with the goal of killing Comrade Stalin, for which reason he had purchased a nagant revolver. For 5 days he watched the Kremlin and quickly tracked comrade Stalin, but he was unable to see the latter and, noticing "suspicious" persons around him and, taking them for OGPU agents, he disappeared. After this incident, he made no attempts to fulfill his intention. When asked whether he would cross over to the Soviet side on assignment from the Romanian intelligence service to carry out the same task, Maier replied that he would do so with pleasure. Maier's sister lives in Romania, but he does not know exactly where. The Moldovan Department petitions for a reward for border guard Bodrov for the detention of the violator Maier.

On 24 June at 06:00, border guards of the Tiraspol' zastava detained Il'ia Dudiaichenik, 24, of Mar'ianovka, Grossulovo raion (Odessa oblast), son of a tax defaulter, who was trying to swim across to relatives on the right bank.

On the same day at 23:00 in the city of Slobodzeia at section 35, border guards found a float which had been prepared to cross to the right bank to reunite with her husband. The float was built by her husband who had left before her…
On 24 June at 14:00 a sentry of the Chobruchi zastava found a set of men's underwear on the left bank. In all probability one unknown person broke through to the right bank here.

On the 25th of June at 12 in the area of Nezavertailovka, patrolman Tikhopovii saw 300 metres away one unknown man heading to the right bank with a float. The patrolman tried to call attention to the unknown man, who rushed into the Dniester and tried to cross to the other side. As a result of the border guard using his weapon, the unknown began to turn back to the left bank, where he then tried to run away from the patrolman. The patrolman... [chased him] and decisively used his weapon - killing the violator. The deceased turned out to be the citizen of Nezavertailovka - Duduv, a 20 year old kulak. An investigation is ongoing into the use of weaponry.

On 25 June at 01:00, near Goiany (zastava 16), a Red Army sentry of the UNR guard saw an unknown man creeping towards the Dniester from the Soviet rear. After warnings he was fired on; he fired back several times with a revolver, putting one bullet through the sentry's cap, and escaped into the Soviet rear. A search found nothing. He may have been a Romanian intelligence agent trying to get back to the right bank.

On the 26th of June at midday on the right bank near the village of Chobruchi, the border guards found a large crate. Upon inspecting the area, on the left bank there were footsteps from the box leading back to a garden that backed onto the Dniester. At this point, 300 metres from the bank, we found nails and a hammer. It was eventually established that at night on the 26th of June at that point, the citizen of Chobruchi Grigorii Vornik, 45, a seredniak, crossed the river in the crate with his 5 children. It seems Vornik crossed with his family to the other bank... The investigation into the violation of the demarcation is ongoing.
